name: create-hooks
description: Create, debug, audit, and port lifecycle hooks that run in both Claude Code and Codex

interface.shortDescription: Lifecycle hooks that run in Codex and Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Builds hooks from tested bash templates on a shared helper that parses one payload and answers in a shape both runtimes accept. Includes fixture payloads for each runtime, a test runner that reports outcome and latency, and a validator that inventories and lints every hook a project runs.
defaultPrompt: Add a hook that blocks dangerous shell commands
Audit the hooks this project runs
Make my Claude Code hooks work in Codex
